content:
Medical insurance covers employees, spouse and children.

Parents are not covered under the standard plan.

Hospitalization expenses are cashless at network hospitals.

Employees are entitled to 20 annual leaves every calendar year.

Unused leaves can be carried forward for up to 5 days.

Manager approval is required before taking leave.

Employees can claim travel reimbursement for approved business trips.

Taxi, flight and hotel expenses are reimbursable.

Receipts must be submitted within 15 days.
